filter_repo_objects_paths: filter repo objects by allow_patterns and ignore_patterns using Unix shell-style wildcards on string paths
filter_repo_objects_with_key: filter arbitrary objects from an iterable using a key function to extract paths for pattern matching
filter_repo_objects_denylist: filter repo objects by ignoring hidden files and directories matching ignore_patterns
filter_repo_objects_allowlist: filter repo objects by allowing only files matching specific extension patterns like *.pdf
add_wildcard_to_directories: append wildcard suffix to directory patterns ending with a trailing slash
